```{r setup, include=FALSE}
require(knitr)
require(tidyverse)
require(plotly)

sampleFData <- params$sampleFData()
# areaBios <- sort(unique(sampleFData$AreaBio))
# spConBios <- sort(unique(sampleFData$SpConBio))
# waterNames <- sort(unique(sampleFData$WaterName))
# stationCode <- sort(unique(sampleFData$StationCode))
# surveyIds <- sort(unique(sampleFData$SurveyID))

```

`r if(params$summaryTable$display) "## Summary Table"`

```{r summaryTable, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE,message=FALSE,error=FALSE}
if(params$summaryTable$display){
  groupByCols <- params$summaryTable$groupingCols
  
  sampleFSummarized <- sampleFData %>%
    mutate(Year = year(SampleDate)) %>%
    group_by(across(any_of(groupByCols))) %>%
    summarize(`Number of Fish` = n(), 
              `Average Length (mm)` = round(mean(Length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
              `Median Length (mm)` = round(median(Length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
              `Min Length (mm)` = round(min(Length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
              `Max Length (mm)` = round(max(Length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
              `Standard Deviation (mm)` = round(sd(Length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
    )
  
  datatable(sampleFSummarized,
            rownames = FALSE,
            extensions = c('Buttons'),
            #for slider filter instead of text input
            filter = 'top',
            options = list(
              pageLength = 10, info = TRUE, lengthMenu = list(c(10,25, 50, 100, 200), c("10", "25", "50","100","200")),
              dom = 'lfrtip', #had to add 'lowercase L' letter to display the page length again #errorin list: arg 5 is empty because I had a comma after the dom argument so it thought there was gonna be another argument input
              language = list(emptyTable = "Enter inputs and press Render Table")
              #buttons = c('csv', 'excel')
            )
  )
}

```

`r if(params$lengthWeightGraph$display) "## Length/Weights"`

```{r lwGraph, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
if(params$lengthWeightGraph$display){
  #using .data pronoun to access column by string
  plot <- sampleFData %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[params$lengthWeightGraph$lengthOptions]], y = .data[[params$lengthWeightGraph$weightOptions]], 
               color = CommonName, 
               text = paste0('Length: ', as.character(round(.data[[params$lengthWeightGraph$lengthOptions]], 2)),
                             '<br>Weight: ', as.character(round(.data[[params$lengthWeightGraph$weightOptions]], 2)), 
                             '<br>Species: ', CommonName, 
                             '<br>Survey ID: ', SurveyID
               )
    )) +
    geom_point() + 
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = "Length/Weight Data") #+
  #scale_color_manual(values = allColors)
  ggplotly(plot, tooltip = "text")
  
} #else{
    #asis_output("## Parameter not selected")

#}
```

`r if(params$lengthFrequencyGraph$display) "## Length Frequencies"`

```{r lfGraph, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
if(params$lengthFrequencyGraph$display){

  plot <- sampleFData %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[params$lengthFrequencyGraph$lengthOptions]], 
               fill = CommonName)) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = "Length Frequencies", caption = "Binwidth = 20mm")
  
  if(params$lengthFrequencyGraph$lengthOptions == "RSD"){
    sampleFDataRSD <- sampleFData %>%
      count(RSD, CommonName, name = "Count") %>%
      left_join(params$rsdLimits, by = "CommonName") %>%
      mutate(hoverText = case_when(RSD == "Stock" ~ paste0(CommonName, " 'Stock' Range (mm): ", SLEN, " - ", QLEN), 
                                   RSD == "Quality" ~ paste0(CommonName, " 'Quality' Range (mm): ", QLEN, " - ", PLEN), 
                                   RSD == "Preferred" ~ paste0(CommonName, " 'Preferred' Range (mm): ", PLEN, " - ", MLEN), 
                                   RSD == "Memorable" ~ paste0(CommonName, " 'Memorable' Range (mm): ", MLEN, " - ", TLEN), 
                                   RSD == "Trophy" ~ paste0(CommonName, " 'Trophy' Range (mm): ", TLEN, "+"), 
                                   TRUE ~ paste0(CommonName, ": No RSD Assigned")
                                   
      ), 
      RSD = factor(RSD, levels = c("Stock", "Quality", "Preferred", "Memorable", "Trophy"))) %>%
      ungroup()
    plot <- ggplot(sampleFDataRSD, aes(x = RSD, y = Count, fill = CommonName, text = hoverText)) +
      geom_col()
    
    
    # plot <- plot +
    #   geom_histogram(stat = "count", 
    #                  aes(
    #                    #group = CommonName,
    #                    # label = RSD,
    #                    # fill = CommonName,
    #                    # label = paste0( 'RSD: ', RSD,
    #                    #                 '<br>Species: ', CommonName
    #                    # ),
    #                    text = paste0(#'RSD: ', RSD,
    #                                    #'<br>Species: ', CommonName,
    #                                  "<br>Count: ", after_stat(count)
    #                    )
    #                  )
    #                  
    #   )
  } else{
    plot <- sampleFData %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = .data[[params$lengthFrequencyGraph$lengthOptions]], 
                 fill = CommonName)) +
      #theme_classic() +
      # labs(title = "Length Frequencies", caption = "Binwidth = 20mm") +
      geom_histogram(binwidth = 20, 
                     aes(
                       group = CommonName,
                       label = CommonName,
                       text = paste0('Length (mm) Range: ', after_stat(xmin), " to ", after_stat(xmax),  
                                     "<br>Count: ", after_stat(count),
                                     '<br>Species: ', after_stat(label)
                       )
                     )) 
  }
  plot <- plot + 
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = "Length Frequencies") #, caption = "Binwidth = 20mm"

  #+
  #scale_fill_manual(values = allColors)
  ggplotly(plot, tooltip = "text")
  
} 
```
